description: This is a Python source file implementing a chatbot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech processing, LLM services, and WebSocket transport, with event handlers for client connection and disconnection, and user/assistant turn stopping events.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of the pipeline, including handling signals.
